description: Canonical frontend performance budgets for V2-FE-130. Route JS budgets are raw uncompressed first-load byte counts (1 KiB = 1024 bytes) enforced at build time against .next/diagnostics/route-bundle-stats.json generated by next build. Web-vitals budgets are enforced at runtime by the PerformanceBudgetIndicator using browser PerformanceObserver data. The Next 16 and TypeScript 6 repair baseline was reviewed after reducing /identity from 1562.6 to 1559.3 KiB and global client JS from 6430.0 to 6408.2 KiB; the narrow limits below preserve less than 1.0 and 2.0 KiB headroom respectively and must not be loosened without review.
